verses.1: And when you divide the land into sections, you shall take a portion of it as a sacred offering for Jehovah. This sacred offering should be five hundred thousand cubits in length and width. It should be located around every boundary line of the land.
verses.2: It will be surrounded by five layers, each layer being five times as thick. And there will be fifty meters in circumference around it.
verses.3: And from this measurement, it will be five hundred and twenty thousand long, and twelve thousand wide. And in it will be the Holy Place, a place of great sanctity.
verses.4: The Holy One from the earth is the priests who serve the Temple. They are those who come to serve Jehovah. They will have a place where they can live, and they will also be able to serve God in a sacred place.
verses.5: And fifty-three thousand units long, and twelve thousand units wide. It would serve as the servants of the houses for them to possess. Forty units were given to them as property.
verses.6: The ownership of the city shall be given to them, in the amount of five thousand square miles in length and fifty thousand square miles in width. This will be a tribute to the Holy One, for every household in Israel.
verses.7: And from there, it extends to the sacred territory and the control over the city. From the edge of the sacred territory to the edge of the city’s territory, from the sea on one side to the Kedemah on the other side. This extends across one of the regions along the coast from the sea to the Kedemah.
verses.8: To the land, it shall belong to Israel. Its rulers will no longer rule over it. The land will be given to the House of Israel for their use.
verses.9: As the Lord God says: “O kings of Israel, Hamash and Shod have removed you from your positions. They have done judgment and righteousness. They have brought down your altars from above my people. Now, O Lord God, do something about this!”
verses.10: May righteousness be upon you, and may justice and righteousness be with you.
verses.11: The father and the daughter will be one. They will carry the heavy load of iron from the daughter’s house to the iron. The iron will be prepared in this way.
verses.12: And the weight is forty gerahs, forty shakels. Five and twenty shakels, twelve and five shakels. This measurement will be for you.
verses.13: This is the gold that you refined from the copper of the sheep, and you refined it from the copper of the goats.
verses.14: And the law of the bough: the bough is made of twelve branches from the trunk. Twelve branches make up the bough; it’s made of wood, just like twelve branches together make up a bough.
verses.15: And one of the sheep from the flocks in Israel shall be used as an offering for sacrifices, both for offerings to God and for other purposes. May the Lord speak through me.
verses.16: All the people of the land shall be part of this offering for the leader of Israel.
verses.17: And over the priest shall be the offering of sacrifices, the offerings for sin, and the offerings on the festivals and holidays. He shall perform these rituals in all the assemblies of the house of Israel.
verses.18: Thus said Adonai Yehovah at the beginning of the month: “Take fresh wheat in the morning, and sanctify the Holy Place.”
verses.19: And the priest took some of the blood from the sin offering, and he poured it onto the altar of the house, as well as onto all four corners of the altar. This was done as an offering for the priest.
verses.20: And so, it shall be done on the seventh day, by a man who is strong and able to carry heavy loads. They shall also prepare the house for use.
verses.21: On the first day of the fourteenth day of the month, it will be your Passover. It’s a holiday that lasts for fourteen days. During this time, you should eat unleavened bread.
verses.22: And in that day, the chief priest did what was wrong, and he did it in the name of all the people of the land.
verses.23: And on the seven days of the festival, there will be seven sacrifices and seven young oxen offered to God. These sacrifices will be offered on the seventh day of those seven days. And there will also be a sacrifice of a wild goat on that day.
verses.24: And where shall the lamb be sacrificed? And where shall the grain be used as food? And where shall the wine be used as drink?
verses.25: On the seventh day of the fifteenth day of the month, during this holiday, one should observe these seven days as if they were a day of sin. This applies to all aspects related to sacrifices, offerings, and other rituals.
